name: agent-workflow
description: Run agent-workflow multi-agent workflows (deep-review, deep-research, spec-review, impact-review, dynamic) from the conversation: launch, wait, inspect and stop runs through the agent-workflow MCP server.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; w="$d/.agent-workflow/workflows"; [ -d "$w" ] || exit 0; s="$d/.agent-workflow/notify-check/hook-claude-code.stamp"; [ -f "$s" ] && [ -z "$(find "$w" -name run.json -newer "$s" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" ] && exit 0; (cd "$d" && npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow notify-check --host claude-code --stamp hook-claude-code 2>/dev/null); exit 0

monitors.name: run-completion
monitors.command: s="$CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"; [ -n "$s" ] || exit 0; d="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; [ -n "$d" ] || d=.; until [ -d "$d/.agent-workflow/workflows" ]; do sleep 5; done; cd "$d" && exec npx -y --package=@agwab/agent-workflow@0.1.0 agent-workflow notify-check --follow --host claude-code --session "$s"
monitors.description: agent-workflow: a run this session started has finished
